chunks.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبْدُوسٍ الْعَطَّارُ النَّيْسَابُورِيُّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ

translations.en: Abdul Wahid ibn Muhammad ibn 'Abdus al-Attar al-Nisapuri (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying:

chunks.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قُتَيْبَةَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُوسَى الرِّضَا ع مَنْ أَقَرَّ بِتَوْحِيدِ اللَّهِ وَ نَفَى التَّشْبِيهَ عَنْهُ وَ نَزَّهَهُ عَمَّا لَا يَلِيقُ بِهِ وَ أَقَرَّ بِأَنَّ لَهُ الْحَوْلَ وَالْقُوَّةَ وَالْإِرَادَةَ وَالْمَشِيَّةَ وَالْخَلْقَ وَالْأَمْرَ وَالْقَضَاءَ وَالْقَدَرَ وَ أَنَّ أَفْعَالَ الْعِبَادِ مَخْلُوقَةٌ خَلْقَ تَقْدِيرٍ لَا خَلْقَ تَكْوِينٍ وَ شَهِدَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا وَالْأَئِمَّةَ بَعْدَهُ حُجَجُ اللَّهِ وَ وَالَى أَوْلِيَاءَهُمْ وَ اجْتَنَبَ الْكَبَائِرَ وَ أَقَرَّ بِالرَّجْعَةِ وَ الْمُتْعَتَيْنِ وَ آمَنَ بِالْمُسَاءَلَةِ فِي الْقَبْرِ وَالْحَوْضِ وَالشَّفَاعَةِ وَ خَلْقِ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ وَالصِّرَاطِ وَالْمِيزَانِ وَالْبَعْثِ وَالنُّشُورِ وَالْجَزَاءِ وَالْحِسَابِ فَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ حَقًّا وَ هُوَ مِنْ شِيعَتِنَا أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ

translations.en: Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Qutaybah narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, who said: Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him) said: Whoever affirms the oneness of Allah, denies anthropomorphism regarding Him, and exalts Him from what does not befit Him, and affirms that might, power, will, volition, creation, command, decree, and destiny belong to Him, and believes that the acts of the servants are created by way of predestination, not by way of formation, and testifies that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, and that Ali and the Imams after him are the proofs of Allah, and loves their allies, avoids major sins, affirms the Raj'ah (return), the two Mut'ahs, and has faith in the questioning in the grave, the Pool, intercession, the creation of Paradise and Hell, the Path, the Balance, the raising, the Resurrection, the recompense, and the reckoning, then he is a true believer and is from our Shia, the People of the House.

en.summary: Imam al-Rida defines the 'Shi'a' not merely by tribal affiliation but by a comprehensive theological and practical identity, emphasizing the distinction between creation by decree (khalq taqdir) and creation by formation (khalq takwin) to clarify the nature of human acts. This definition integrates core Sunni-Shia shared beliefs with distinct Shia doctrines such as the Raj'ah and the two Mut'ahs, establishing a holistic framework for faith that includes eschatological markers like the Hawd and Shafa'ah. The hadith serves as a foundational criterion for identifying true adherents of the Ahl al-Bayt through both intellectual affirmation and behavioral conduct.
en.seo_question: What are the essential criteria for being considered a true Shia according to Imam al-Rida?

id.summary: Imam al-Rida mendefinisikan 'Syi'ah' bukan sekadar berdasarkan afiliasi suku, melainkan melalui identitas teologis dan praktis yang komprehensif, dengan menekankan perbedaan antara penciptaan melalui ketetapan (khalq taqdir) dan penciptaan melalui pembentukan (khalq takwin) untuk menjelaskan hakikat perbuatan manusia. Definisi ini mengintegrasikan keyakinan inti yang disepakati Sunni-Syi'ah dengan doktrin Syi'ah yang khas seperti Raj'ah dan dua Mut'ah, sehingga membentuk kerangka iman yang holistik yang mencakup penanda eskatologis seperti Hawd dan Syafa'ah. Hadis ini berfungsi sebagai kriteria dasar untuk mengidentifikasi pengikut sejati Ahl al-Bayt melalui pengakuan intelektual dan perilaku.
id.seo_question: Apa kriteria esensial untuk dianggap sebagai Syi'ah sejati menurut Imam al-Rida?
